sharedRules.name: BITTER AND TWISTED (2)
sharedRules.description: Until the end of the current Round, all models in the warband of race ELF, have the Vicious special rule.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Weeping Sores
sharedRules.description: Roll to hit and wound the target. In addition to any damage that may be caused, the target suffers a -1 modifier to all Melee and Ranged attacks it makes for the remainder of the Round.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Summon the Reaper
sharedRules.description:
Choose any enemy model within Range, even those out of LOS or that are Engaged. Place a Nightstalker Reaper model anywhere within 3” of the target model and not within 1” of any other models. It may be Activated in a subsequent Turn. While in play, the Reaper is part of the caster’s warband but doesn’t count towards the Warband’s break limit for making Fallback checks. While it is in play, in the End phase of each Round, roll a die. On a result
of 1 or 2, the Reaper is removed from play. The casting model may only have one such Reaper model in play at any one time.

sharedRules.name: Whirlwind of Steel
sharedRules.description: Enemy models making a Melee attack against this model, even if it is knocked-down, suffer a -1 modifier when rolling to hit.

sharedRules.name: BATTLE RAGE (2)
sharedRules.description: If this model can Engage an enemy model with a follow-up move, it may spend the Power and Engage that model and initiate another Melee by using the ability to go into a Battle Rage. This model will not get any bonus dice for charging however. Once this second Melee has been resolved, mark this model as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: RANGE BOOST (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability to increase the range of one of the caster’s spells by 3” (where a Range is specified). The RANGE BOOST must be paid for during the caster’s activation just before the chosen spell is cast.
